title: Bear
wikitext:
[[image:bear.png|thumb|]]

A very common, bulky, furry, four-legged [[beast|Beast]] that lopes along on all fours, but may occasionally rise up on hind legs. Most '''bears''' are [[Hostile|hostile]] when approached, despite their sometimes cuddly appearance. They tend to be larger than human sized at their smallest.  Bears are found in [[Dun Morogh]], [[Loch Modan]], the [[Hillsbrad Foothills]], [[Ashenvale]], [[Feralas]], the [[Western Plaguelands]], [[Darkshore]], [[Elwynn Forest]], [[Silverpine Forest]], and [[Winterspring]].

== Traits ==
* Bear pets sometimes have the [[claw]] ability when [[Beast_Taming|tamed]].
* There are varieties of "plagued" bears that roam [[Felwood]] and the [[Western Plaguelands]].

== Examples ==
* Black Bear 
* Dire Bear 
* Gray Bear 
* Thistle Bear 
* [[Polar Bear]] 

==  As A [[Hunter]] Pet ==
* Have high HP, medium armor, and low damage.
* Eats Meat, Fish, Fungus, Fruit, Cheese, and Bread, making them extraordinarily easy to feed.
* Can learn [[Bite]], [[Cower]], [[Claw]], and [[Growl]].  They have yet to recieve their species skill.
* Very popular as Hunter pets due to their easy diet and tanking stats.
* Ursius and the Young Forest Bear are two of the only known hunter pets with a swing speed higher than 2.0.  This means they hit less often, but for more damage.
